about_the_game:
If you could change a friend's painful memories by sacrificing their most cherished objects, how far would you go ?

France, 2091. At the crossroads of neuropsychology, demonology and engineering lies the greatest creation of the century : the Memory Palace. A virtual place that anyone can build when their case seems beyond saving to everybody but a very few selected people called Healers. A place where confronting your Inner Demon becomes possible, to better understand it as well as destroy it.

You are the most renowned Healer of the country, and a friend asked for your help. Uncover memories by interacting with various objects, learn more about what happened, and get closer to your friend if you want to. You will need as much knowledge as you can to confront the Inner Demon inhabiting her once and for all. 

FEATURES

  • Intuitive movement avoiding South/North/East/West design.

  • A character with whom you can deepen your relationship.

  • Important choices where there is no good or wrong answers.

  • Multiple endings with variations for each one.

content_descriptors.notes: The game talks about trauma and death through dialogue, description and game mechanics

short_description: A text-based adventure about exorcising your friend’s Inner Demon by sacrificing her most cherished objects. Explore a place where memories are tangible, learn more about each object, engage with your friend and choose what to do with the being inhabiting her.
